movie.title: Jim Queen
movie.overview: When Heterosis - a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a mysterious virus begins turning gay men straight in Paris, gym-obsessed Pride icon Jim must team up with an earnest newcomer to find a cure before his community vanishes.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In the heart of the Parisian gay scene, Jim reigns supreme as the six-packed sovereign of the Gym Queens until a strange virus called Heterosis begins turning gay men straight. As the outbreak spreads, Jim suddenly finds himself stripped of his status and cast out by the rapidly transforming social scene. Left with only Lucien, an affectionate and freshly-out twink, Jim sets off on a desperate mission to stop the epidemic. Together, they must navigate a changing city and race against time to save the vibrant community that once worshipped him.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Jim is the undisputed monarch of the Parisian gay nightlife, celebrated for his flawless physique and reigning at the top of the Gym Queens hierarchy. However, his glamorous world collapses when 'Heterosis,' a bizarre virus that abruptly converts gay men into heterosexuals, begins sweeping through Paris. One by one, Jim's peers, friends, and admirers lose their passion for the scene, leaving him alienated in a culture he once dominated. Stripped of his royal status and isolated from his usual circle, Jim finds an unlikely ally in Lucien, a newly out young man who possesses far more heart than muscle. Recognizing the existential threat to their culture and identity, the duo embarks on a high-stakes quest across the city to discover the origin of the virus and forge a cure. Along the way, Jim is forced to confront his own vanity, shallow values, and what true community actually means. Lucien's unwavering loyalty acts as Jim's emotional anchor while they track down leads through hidden corners of the transforming Parisian nightlife. With the virus threatening to erase the city's gay heritage entirely, Jim must prove he is more than just a sculpted torso to save the people and culture he holds dear.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of the Parisian gay scene, *Jim Queen* is an animated comedy-drama that follows Jim, the prized muscle-bound icon of the local Gym Queens. When a mysterious virus known as 'Heterosis' starts turning gay men straight, the vibrant nightlife quickly unravels. Discarded by a rapidly altering society, Jim teams up with Lucien—a naive, newly out young man—to find a cure. Combining sharp humor with genuine heart, the story explores themes of identity, superficiality, and solidarity as Jim fights to preserve his imperiled community.
